description: Highway-Rail Grade Crossing Accident/Incident Source Data (Form 57) is a dataset listed in data.transportation.gov (U.S. DOT open data portal), an open data portal of the U.S. Department of Transportation under the section "Railroads", published or maintained by FRA Safe Team. All impacts between railroad on-track equipment and highway users at a highway-rail grade crossing are reported by railroads to the FRA on Form FRA F 6180.57 Highway-Rail Grade Crossing Accident/Incident Report. This dataset is the source dataset and contains raw data values. Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Railroads". It has 103 columns, among them PASSINJ, GXID, REGION, VEHDIR, VISIBLTY, RR2. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. Attribution given: FRA Safe Team. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-usdot-data-transportation-gov-portal.
